_comments: The BizApps Credentialing Application — what puts Credentialing in the MemberJunction Explorer app switcher.
ClassName selects CredentialingApplication (@mj-biz-apps/credentialing-ng), which decides per user which nav items
they SEE, from their roles (Staff: Program Studio; Admin: Set up organization / New organization;
Reviewer or Committee: Assignments; Applicant: My Applications).
DefaultNavItems lists EVERY item the app can show, one per label, because Explorer's route guard resolves
/app/credentialing/<item> deep links (and their query parameters) from this list only. It is therefore not the
least-privilege list: each resource guards itself (AreaNav.CanOpen) and shows 'This area is not available to your
account.' to a user whose roles do not serve it. If CredentialingApplication is not loaded, Explorer shows this
whole list, and the resources still guard themselves.
Each item is ResourceType Custom pointing at a DriverClass registered with

fields.Name: Credentialing
fields.Description: Credentialing, certification, and licensure management for MemberJunction: credential definitions, requirements, holder records, verification, expiration and renewal cycles.
